title: For Car & Two-Wheeler Owners
subtitle: Keep your RC, insurance, PUC, warranties, and challans unified by registration plate.
coreProblem: Indian vehicle owners juggle at least four separate expiry cycles: 6-month PUCs, 1-year motor insurance, 3-year extended warranties, and periodic camera challans. A single lapsed PUC invites a ₹10,000 fine; an insurance lapse over 90 days destroys your accrued No Claim Bonus (up to 50% premium discount).

howVaultHelps.title: Automatic Multi-Hop Vehicle Grouping
howVaultHelps.description: Upload your car's RC once. SQUARES Vault connects every subsequent insurance policy, PUC certificate, service invoice, and e-challan to that vehicle plate automatically.

howVaultHelps.title: Triple-Tier Expiry Notifications
howVaultHelps.description: Never get caught off guard at traffic checkpoints. Receive notifications at 10 days, 2 days, and same-day with 1-tap Snooze and Renewal links.

howVaultHelps.title: Instant On-Demand Retrieval
howVaultHelps.description: When questioned by a traffic officer or visiting an authorized service center, type 'Give me docs for my Venue' to pull up your records in 3 seconds.

quote: I used to maintain a spreadsheet for 2 cars and a scooter. Now I just forward the PDF whenever renewal arrives, and SQUARES Vault tracks the rest.

Invoices are printed on thermal roll paper that fades to blank within months, while health insurance cards and utility bills get buried in disorganized WhatsApp family groups.

howVaultHelps.title: Permanent Proof-of-Purchase Storage

howVaultHelps.title: Annual Maintenance & Warranty Tracking

title: For Tenants & Landlords
subtitle: Track 11-month lease expirations, notice periods, and electricity meter deposits without friction.
coreProblem: Tenancy relationships in India run on 11-month lease agreements. Forgetting the 30-day or 60-day notice period frequently leads to forfeiture of security deposit interest or disputes over rent escalations. Meanwhile, utility bills must be tracked monthly to prove address residency for banking and passport renewals.

howVaultHelps.title: 11-Month Term Countdown
howVaultHelps.description: Logs commencement and expiry dates from your registered or notarized rent agreement, scheduling alerts ahead of mandatory notice windows.

howVaultHelps.title: Address Proof Freshness Guarantee
howVaultHelps.description: Indian passport offices and banks reject electricity bills older than 3 months. Upload monthly utility PDFs to always have an active address document ready.

howVaultHelps.title: Security Deposit Tracking
howVaultHelps.description: Maintains a permanent verifiable log of advance deposits, escalation clauses, and handover terms in your personal Google Drive.

quote: I manage 3 rented apartments. Keeping track of which 11-month contract is expiring and reminding tenants about renewal is now completely hands-off.
